A typed map of mathematical transformations across eight domains, with its fill layer, audit, receipts, formal links and Lean project.
dirs.audit: The audit: the fixed random sample, its field-by-field grades, and the targeted grades.
dirs.audit/blind: The blind second reading of the Mathlib match grades: the packet, the answer key, and each reader's grades.
dirs.catalogue: The paper catalogue: every paper the map cites and how deeply it has been read.
dirs.catalogue/imports: Paper lists imported from sibling repositories, bibliographic fields and reading status only.
dirs.domains: The map, readable, one file per domain (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
dirs.excerpts: Verbatim windows that receipt claims, each with its source URL and the hash of the source as fetched.
dirs.lean: A Lean 4 project on the pinned Mathlib that states and proves claims Mathlib does not cover.
dirs.lean/MathMap: The Lean sources, one file per topic, each naming the entries it bears on.
dirs.mapfill: The fill layer the parser applies over the landed map: clone resolution, fills, additions, conditions, corrections, invariants and formal links.
dirs.reports: Generated reports on data quality, error rates, the catalogue and the formal queue.
dirs.scripts: The parser, query tool, checks, build and tool server. Node, no dependencies.
dirs.source: The map as landed, verbatim, and the report its D7 names come from.

docs..github/workflows/check.yml: CI: runs scripts/check-all.mjs, and builds the Lean project and verifies its audit.
docs.LICENSE: CC BY 4.0 for the data, MIT for the scripts.
docs.MANIFEST.json: The source commit and the hash of every generated file (generated).
docs.README.md: What the map is, its origins, tiers, evidence levels and layout (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
docs.SHA256SUMS: The generated files' hashes in sha256sum form (generated).
docs.audit.json: The audit grades with their quotes and sources, machine-readable (generated).
docs.audit/blind/key-0_1.json: The item ids of the blind packet, for a reader's answers.
docs.audit/blind/packet-0_1.md: The blind packet: each Mathlib link's claim and quoted Lean statement, without the grade.
docs.audit/sample-0_1.json: The fixed stratified sample of 60 entries, drawn before grading.
docs.catalogue/papers.json: The paper catalogue's source: ids, entries cited, reading status and excerpts.
docs.infra.json: Configuration of the vendored Repo-Infrastructure kit: which checks run.
docs.infra.lock.json: Pins the vendored kit in .infra/: upstream commit and the hash of every file.
docs.lean/.gitignore: Keeps Lake's build directory out of git.
docs.lean/AUDIT.json: Each registered declaration's axioms, status (proved or stated) and dependencies, regenerated by scripts/lean.mjs --audit.
docs.lean/MathMap.lean: The library root; imports every MathMap module.
docs.lean/MathMap/Cone.lean: The cone on a space as a quotient, contractible when the space is nonempty (D4-075).
docs.lean/MathMap/HTransform.lean: The Doob h-transform of Brownian motion with h(x) = x, giving the Bessel-3 generator (D5-037).
docs.lean/MathMap/LawvereTierney.lean: Lawvere-Tierney topologies, read in the truth values (D7-288).
docs.lean/MathMap/Meta.lean: Audit support: the #mathmap_deps command that lists the MathMap definitions a statement depends on.
docs.lean/MathMap/OpenGames.lean: Open games and their monoidal product (D7-X04).
docs.lean/MathMap/SubtoposColimits.lean: The inclusion of a subtopos need not preserve colimits (D7-X02).
docs.lean/MathMap/Topos.lean: Subtoposes, essential geometric morphisms and levels.
docs.lean/WISHLIST.md: What the map's claims need from Mathlib and do not find there, ordered by the links each would unlock.
docs.lean/lake-manifest.json: Lake's pinned dependencies (Mathlib at the map's pinned commit).
docs.mapfill/README.md: What the fill layer is, what it corrects in the landed map, and how fills are graded.
docs.reports/AUDIT.md: Audit error rates by stratum and field, with every grade's receipt (generated by scripts/audit.mjs).
docs.reports/FORMAL-QUEUE.md: Unreviewed name matches against Mathlib, still to be read (generated by scripts/formal.mjs).
docs.reports/MATHMAP.md: Data quality of the parsed and filled map (generated by scripts/mathmap.mjs).
docs.reports/SECOND-READING.md: The blind second reading compared with the map's grades (generated by scripts/blind.mjs).
docs.source/Category_Theory_Transformation_En: The D7 mapper report the D7 names come from.
docs.source/math_map.md: The map as landed, verbatim; never edited.

families.domains/D*.md: One domain of the map, readable (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
families.excerpts/mathlib-*.txt: Mathlib declaration statements at the pinned commit, quoted verbatim, with each file's hash.
families.excerpts/wikipedia-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a Wikipedia page at a pinned revision (CC BY-SA).
families.excerpts/nlab-*.txt: Verbatim windows from an nLab page.
families.excerpts/arxiv-*.txt: Verbatim windows from an arXiv paper.
families.excerpts/econometrica-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a journal article.
families.audit/blind/reader-*.json: One reader's blind grades, with a statement of the reader's independence.
